UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User-specific Focus Garden study profile, onboarding state, syllabus topics, tailored challenges, mood check-in, and reverse alarm time.

onboardingCompleted.description: Whether the user has completed their study & syllabus setup.

currentStudy.description: User's current course, class, or exam (e.g., B.Tech CSE Sem 4, NEET).

syllabusText.description: User-entered syllabus text or extracted summary.

studySummary.description: Short personalized summary of the user's syllabus plan.

customChallenges.description: Personalized Pehli Line micro-challenges based on the user's subjects and syllabus.

challengeIdx.description: Current index in the Pehli Line Challenge rotation.

alarmTime.description: Reverse study alarm target time in HH:mm 24-hour format.

subjectsText.description: Comma-separated subjects entered by the user or extracted from their syllabus.

StudySession.title: StudySession
StudySession.description: A single focus timer session with subject, ambient sound, completion status, reward, and distraction reasons.

done.description: Whether the session completed without giving up or distraction.

rewardText.description: Random motivational sticker and quote earned on completion.

distractionReasons.description: List of distraction reason labels logged during the session.

distractionCount.description: Number of distractions logged in this session.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores each authenticated user's Focus Garden study profile, syllabus details, and settings.

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Stores each authenticated user's study sessions for Focus, Sound Mixer, Distraction Mirror, and Study Diary.
